remarks: Welcome home to this stunning second-floor unit that checks every box for style, comfort, and convenience. Step inside to discover two spacious bedrooms, a beautifully refurbished full bathroom, and a bright office space, perfect for today's work-from-home lifestyle. The entire unit has been freshly painted, and the gleaming hardwood floors add a touch of elegance throughout.  The open-concept layout is designed for modern living, featuring a chic breakfast bar and an updated kitchen outfitted with sleek stainless steel appliances. Host unforgettable dinners in the formal dining room, then unwind in the expansive living room, ideal for cozy nights in or festive holiday gatherings. Recessed lighting elevates the warm, inviting ambiance.  Retreat to the impressive primary bedroom with its massive walk-in closet, offering exceptional storage. Closet space is truly abundant throughout the home! Step outside onto your private back deck, reserved for this unit, your own outdoor oasis for morning coffee or evening relaxation.  Heat and hot water are included for added value and ease.  Situated in one of Stamford's most desirable neighborhoods, you'll enjoy unbeatable access to top amenities, vibrant shopping and dining, major transportation, and a quick 45-minute commute to NYC. This exceptional unit blends luxury, convenience, and lifestyle.
